messages:
lee: heads-up: customer on corporate vpn reports streaming UI stuck. they see repeated small chunks and then nothing.

anya: which sampleapp/sdk/version? can you grab a HAR or tcpdump?

lee: sampleapp web demo (browser sdk v0.9.4). happening only over their VPN. HAR shows multiple `data:` fragments for same event, sometimes reversed order. then connection closes without the terminal blank line.

carlos: VPNs can buffer and re-segment TCP. our SSE parser currently assumes chunk boundaries align with events. that's brittle.

anya: idea: switch parser to line-oriented assembly: read by newline, accumulate fields for an event, flush when we hit blank line OR on stream close OR after idle timeout. makes it tolerant to split/reorder.

lee: what about duplicates? the VPN sometimes resends same bytes on reconnect and we get duplicate partial events.

carlos: add lightweight dedupe: if event-id exists use that; else use sha1 of event body + last-seen-window. expire entries after N seconds. default dedupe window 5s.

anya: also expose idle-flush config so apps can opt-in for aggressive flush on flaky networks. default 600ms. document in sampleapp README under "Troubleshooting: flaky networks & proxies" with small repro using tc/netem.

qa-bot: created issue #2245: "SSE: robust assembly, EOF flush, idle flush, and dedupe". PR expected with tests: unit (reordering/dup), integ (mitmproxy reorder), e2e (headless chrome).

lee: i'll attach their HAR + a minimized repro script. cheers.

carlos: nice. once merged we should ship a quick patch release and update the onboarding guide to mention VPN/proxy caveats.
